'''Jaxon Brand''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and tactician.

He was dedicated to the restoration of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was also committed to the safety and training of his squad. He thinks success comes when everyone returns.

He had originally joined the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], but became disillusioned with the corruption, and was recruited into the Rebel Alliance during officer training.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he was assigned to [[Trivar II]] on a recruitment mission, but had to join a [[Rescue at Glare Peak (event)|rescue]] operation when Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were shot down.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jaxon Brand is one of the pre-generated characters from the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]]. He was then used as one of the pre-generated characters in [[Fantasy Flight Games]] special promotion, ''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''.
